transcript.text: Last spring I ended up in Shanghai for a couple days and kept joking that I should’ve checked what movies were even out while I was there.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The whole trip was that quick hop from Beijing to Shanghai anyway, so I was mostly just running around and didn’t really plan anything fun.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember my friend mentioned taking train G3 on 2025-03-21, and it sounded like it was smooth enough, so I didn’t stress about timing after that.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: They booked it under Sun Lei and picked Second Class, which honestly seemed totally fine for that route.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That same night I tagged along when Deng Hui grabbed a single ticket—movie was YOLO at Shanghai Film Center, the 20:30 showtime, just 1 seat.
